manufacturer_details.section_title: Name and Address of Manufacturer, Packer, or Importer
manufacturer_details.statutory_quote: The name and complete address of the manufacturer, or where the manufacturer is not the packer, the name and complete address of the manufacturer and packer, or in case of imported packages, the name and complete address of the importer.

net_quantity.section_title: Declaration of Net Quantity in Standard Metric Units
net_quantity.statutory_quote: The net quantity, in terms of the standard unit of weight or measure, of the commodity contained in the package or where the commodity is packed or sold by number, the number or unit or piece or pair or set which represents the quantity shall be mentioned.

mrp.section_title: Maximum Retail Price (MRP) Inclusive of All Taxes
mrp.statutory_quote: The maximum retail price at which the commodity in packaged form may be sold to the consumer, inclusive of all taxes, in Indian currency (e.g. MRP Rs. / ? xx.xx, inclusive of all taxes).

unit_sale_price.section_title: Mandatory Declaration of Unit Sale Price
unit_sale_price.statutory_quote: The unit sale price shall be declared as 'Rs./? __ per g' for net qty < 1kg; 'Rs./? __ per kg' for net qty >= 1kg; 'Rs./? __ per ml' for net vol < 1L; 'Rs./? __ per litre' for net vol >= 1L; and 'Rs./? __ per number' for items sold by number.

manufacture_date.section_title: Month and Year of Manufacture or Pre-packing and Best Before Date
manufacture_date.statutory_quote: The month and year in which the commodity is manufactured or pre-packed or imported, and if a commodity may become unfit for human consumption after a period of time, the 'best before' or 'use by date, month and year' shall also be mentioned.

consumer_care.section_title: Consumer Care Details for Consumer Grievance Redressal
consumer_care.statutory_quote: Every package shall bear the name, address, telephone number, and e-mail address of the person who can be contacted by the consumer in case of a complaint or query.

country_of_origin.statutory_quote: The name of the country of origin or manufacture or assembly in case of imported products shall be mentioned on the package.

qr_code_declaration.section_title: QR Code Declarations for Electronic Products
qr_code_declaration.statutory_quote: In the case of an electronic product, the package shall declare the name of manufacturer/packer/importer on the package itself and inform consumers to scan the QR code for address, generic name, size, dimensions, and customer care details.

fssai_license.act_name: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020
fssai_license.statutory_quote: The FSSAI logo and 14-digit license number of the food business operator shall be displayed on the label of the food package in contrast color to the background.

veg_nonveg_symbol.act_name: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020
veg_nonveg_symbol.statutory_quote: Every package of vegetarian food shall bear a green color filled circle inside a square, and non-vegetarian food shall bear a brown color filled triangle inside a square on the principal display panel.

nutritional_info.act_name: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020
nutritional_info.statutory_quote: Nutritional information per 100g or 100ml or per single serving: Energy (kcal), Protein (g), Carbohydrate (g), Total Sugars (g), Added Sugars (g), Total Fat (g), Saturated Fat (g), Trans Fat (g), and Sodium (mg).

ingredients_list.act_name: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020
ingredients_list.section_title: List of Ingredients in Descending Order
ingredients_list.statutory_quote: Ingredients shall be listed in descending order of their composition by weight or volume (m/m or v/v) at the time of manufacture of the food product.

allergen_info.act_name: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020
allergen_info.statutory_quote: Foods containing cereals with gluten, crustacea, fish, eggs, peanuts, soybeans, milk, tree nuts shall declare allergens as 'Contains: <allergen>' or 'May contain traces of...'.

mfg_license_no.act_name: Drugs and Cosmetics Act, 1940 & Cosmetics Rules, 2020
mfg_license_no.statutory_quote: The manufacturing licence number under which the cosmetic is manufactured, preceded by the letters 'M.L. No.' or 'Mfg. Lic. No.'.

batch_lot_number.section_title: Batch or Lot Number for Cosmetic Traceability
batch_lot_number.statutory_quote: A distinctive batch number preceded by the letter 'B' or 'Batch No.' or 'B. No.' or 'Lot No.' to facilitate full traceability.

cosmetic_ingredients.section_title: Cosmetic Ingredients List using INCI Nomenclature
cosmetic_ingredients.statutory_quote: Ingredients present in concentration of more than 1% shall be listed in descending order of weight or volume, followed by those present in concentration up to 1%, using International Nomenclature of Cosmetic Ingredients (INCI).

directions_for_use.section_title: Directions for Safe Use and Application
directions_for_use.statutory_quote: Directions for safe use and application of the cosmetic commodity, including clear step-by-step instructions for consumer safety.

cosmetic_warnings.section_title: Warning and Precautionary Statements for Cosmetics
cosmetic_warnings.statutory_quote: Where danger of fire or injury to health exists, suitable warning statements such as 'For external use only', 'Avoid contact with eyes', 'Keep out of reach of children'.

fibre_composition.section_title: Fibre Composition of Textiles and Finished Garments
fibre_composition.statutory_quote: Percentage of each fibre type present in the garment or piece, e.g., '100% Cotton' or '65% Polyester 35% Cotton'.

size_declaration.section_title: Standard Size Indicators and Metric Dimensions for Garments
size_declaration.statutory_quote: Sizes with internationally recognizable size indicators such as S, M, L, XL, XXL and XXXL along with details in metric notation in terms of cm or m, as the case may be.

wash_care.section_title: Care and Wash Instructions for Finished Garments
wash_care.statutory_quote: Recommended washing, drying, and ironing instructions or ISO standard wash care symbols to preserve garment quality.

bis_registration.act_name: Bureau of Indian Standards (Conformity Assessment) Regulations & CRO Scheme
bis_registration.section_title: Standard Mark and CRS Registration Number
bis_registration.source_document: MeitY / BIS Electronics Compulsory Registration Order
bis_registration.statutory_quote: Self-declaration statement 'Self-Declaration - Conforming to IS ...' with the Standard Mark and official registration number R-XXXXXXXX.

power_ratings.act_name: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 & BIS Standards
power_ratings.section_title: Rated Voltage, Frequency and Wattage Declaration
power_ratings.statutory_quote: The rated voltage (V), operational frequency (Hz), and power input / wattage (W) shall be clearly declared on the electrical apparatus packaging.

pan_masala_no_exemption.section_title: Prohibition of 10g Small Pack Exemption for Pan Masala
pan_masala_no_exemption.statutory_quote: Provided further that the provisions of this clause [exempting packages <= 10g or 10ml from declarations] shall not apply to pan masala. All pan masala packages of any weight must bear complete mandatory declarations.

section_36_penalties.act_name: Legal Metrology Act, 2009 (as amended by Jan Vishwas Act, 2023)
section_36_penalties.section_title: Penalty for Selling, Distributing Non-Compliant Pre-Packaged Commodities
section_36_penalties.source_document: Jan Vishwas (Amendment of Provisions) Act, 2023 (18 of 2023)
section_36_penalties.statutory_quote: Whoever manufactures, packs, imports, sells or distributes any pre-packaged commodity which does not conform to the declarations on the package shall be punished with fine: up to ?25,000 for first offence, ?50,000 for second offence, and up to ?1,00,000 for subsequent offences.

new_mandatory_rules.field_name: QR Code Declaration for Electronic Goods
new_mandatory_rules.description: For electronic products, manufacturer/packer name on package and QR code to access address, dimensions, and customer support details.
new_mandatory_rules.expected_format: Readable QR code with text notice: 'Scan QR code for full details'

new_mandatory_rules.description: Rule 26(a) exemption for <= 10g does NOT apply to Pan Masala. All pan masala packs must display all mandatory declarations.
new_mandatory_rules.expected_format: Full declarations on any pan masala pouch regardless of weight

statutory_penalties.offence: Non-conforming pre-packaged commodity (missing declarations, deceptive packaging)
statutory_penalties.section: Section 36(1) of Legal Metrology Act, 2009 (amended by Jan Vishwas Act, 2023)
statutory_penalties.fine_subsequent: Fine up to Rs. 1,00,000 or imprisonment up to 1 year

statutory_penalties.fine_first_offence: Fine up to Rs. 2,000 to Rs. 5,000
